features.details: The aluminum spaceframe chassis is incredibly rigid, preventing any panel rattling or structural flexing over deep potholes.

features.name: Suspension Damping Comfort

features.name: Thermal & Battery Management
features.details: Excellent active cooling algorithms ensure the battery does not overheat or throttle performance even during hot Indian summers.
